extracted.intended_audience: internal staff, volunteers, designers, and media requesting or producing Habitat for Humanity Central Arizona marketing materials
extracted.subtask_description: Branding and media guidelines for Habitat for Humanity Central Arizona, covering approved colors, logos, designer guides, and the procedure to request marketing materials or permissions. Intended to ensure cohesive, on-brand marketing and to centralize requests through the Marketing Department.

rubrics_metrics.name: Approved Color Palettes
rubrics_metrics.description: The Habitat for Humanity Central Arizona color palette works in conjunction with the National branding strategy to give a cohesive presence to all Habitat for Humanity marketing material and branding.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Hover over the colors to reveal the HEX code, as well as, to download a PNG file to your computer. Use these approved palettes to ensure consistency with national branding.

rubrics_metrics.name: Primary Color Palette (use these primary brand colors)
rubrics_metrics.description: Primary Color Palette: Habitat Bright Blue (Hex: #00AFD7); Habitat Bright Green (Hex: #C4D600); Black (Hex: #000000); White (Hex: #FFFFFF); Habitat Cool Gray (Hex: #888B8D).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These are the core colors for primary brand elements. Use exact HEX values provided; swatches available for download as PNGs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Secondary Color Palette (supporting brand colors)
rubrics_metrics.description: Secondary Color Palette: Habitat Legacy Blue (Hex: #002F6C); Habitat Legacy Green (Hex: #43B02A); Habitat Orange (Hex: #FF671F); Habitat Brick (Hex: #A4343A); Habitat Yellow (Hex: #FFD100).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use these supporting colors alongside the primary palette where appropriate; use exact HEX values; swatches available for download.

rubrics_metrics.name: Submit a marketing request (procedure)
rubrics_metrics.description: To request potential material from Habitat’s marketing and media department, please complete the following form below and submit it to the marketing team for review.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: You will be contacted with questions, and be provided with more information about your request, as soon as marketing has reviewed the request. Provide all important project details when submitting so the Marketing Team can follow up quickly.

rubrics_metrics.name: Marketing & Media intake guidance
rubrics_metrics.description: Please share the important details of your project started and someone from the Marketing Team will follow up with you as quickly as possible.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include clear project scope, deadlines, required assets, and contact information to expedite review and fulfillment by the Marketing Department.

rubrics_metrics.name: Habitat Branding Guide (comprehensive specifications)
rubrics_metrics.description: Download our current brand and standards guide to view Habitat for Humanity logos, approved color palette, typography, fonts, photography, and other branding specifications.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Refer to the full Branding Guide for authoritative rules on logo use, typography, photography style, spacing, and other brand decisions before producing materials.

rubrics_metrics.name: Guides for Designers
rubrics_metrics.description: Designers Guide and Quick Reference Guide are provided as resources for creators working on Habitat materials.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the Designers Guide for detailed guidance and the Quick Reference Guide for fast checks to ensure design work adheres to brand standards.

rubrics_metrics.name: Approved Logos (use with permission)
rubrics_metrics.description: The following logo are available for use with permission from Habitat for Humanity Central Arizona.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use only approved logos provided by the organization and obtain permission where required. Logos are available to download; track and comply with any usage restrictions the Marketing Department specifies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Contact Marketing Department (permissions and questions)
rubrics_metrics.description: Contact Marketing Dept — Phone: 602-268-9022; Office Location: 2830 W Glendale Ave, Suite 33, Phoenix, AZ 85051.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reach out to Marketing for permission to use assets, to submit requests, or to ask branding questions. The Marketing Department will review requests and follow up with necessary details.
